theorems.name: Submission.cbr_smm_liminf_left_slope_le_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F t → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (F t - F (t - h))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F t)
